We need to bring it down!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 24 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Giant''' is a tanky enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] and Fallen Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a high amount of health and decently fast for the amount of health it has. It is a [[Boss]] enemy when it first spawns in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Giants were the kingdom's most honored guardians. They stood watch over the throne room, where they witnessed the Queen's sacrifice. They are vessels of magic lacking free will, and the curse only magnified their power. Massive in size, they make for great defenders and one could tell a Giant was coming by the shaking of the ground upon each step.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Giant''' is a large, hulking entity with black skin. It has multiple blue cracks in its body. It wears a torn, off-white coat, cyan-grey gloves and has strange tubing and devices on its head. Its skull is partially exposed and it has a knife on its back. ==Strategy== *The '''Fallen Giant''' is quite a step-up in difficulty compared to other enemies that debut before it. Despite not having defense by default at all, its high health and relatively early arrival make up for this. **Using high, relatively affordable DPS towers, such as the [[Engineer]], [[Hunter]], [[Ranger]] and [[Golden Minigunner]] can be sufficient to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]], [[Commander]] and [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to boost these towers. *On Wave 25, three '''Fallen Giant's''' appear along with the debut of the [[Fallen Jester]]. This combo is extremely deadly due to the [[Fallen Jester]]'s ''Devious Tricks'' ability that can give the '''Fallen Giants''' [[Bloated]] and [[Blessed]], greatly buffing them. In total, all three of them with [[Bloated]] have a combined health of 24,000, as well as 100% defense from the [[Blessed]] attribute. **You should use high DPS towers such as the [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] and [[Accelerator]] to focus on the '''Fallen Giants''' and a few focused on the [[Fallen Jester]]. Because the [[Fallen Jester]] is faster, it is best to set some towers to ''First'' and the rest to ''Strongest'' or ''Last'' to maximize the damage potential. **The [[Saboteur]] can be used to force your towers to target the [[Fallen Jester]]s. *The '''Fallen Giant''' has the [[Stun Immunity]], making it only get slowed down by stuns and making it fully immune to knockback. **Do note however that certain forms of stalling, like freeze or some specific cases like the [[Confusion Ducky]], the duration of the stall will be shorter due to its larger size. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenGiantWalk.gif|Walking animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenGiant.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenGiant.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Gatling Gun Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Giant''' on a promotional video. Medic & Turret Update Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Giant''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexFallenGiant.png|'''Fallen Giant''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The model used by the '''Fallen Giant''' was originally made for the [[Giant Boss]], though it was later re-textured and used for the '''Fallen Giant'''. **The [[Giant Boss]] model would not be added until the 18th of September 2025. *The knife that is on the '''Fallen Giant''' is the {{RLinkC|121946387|Bombo's Survival Knife}} from the Roblox Catalog. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''2 August 2024''' -
